'''Gray 12''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[operative]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Gray 12 was on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] and issued a travel advisory that an additional [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] had been assigned to [[Terril Naval Base]].<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>
